Imagine you are riding your bike up a really steep hill. It’s hard work, right? Your legs feel heavy, and you’re moving super slowly. Now, imagine you are zooming down a flat road with the wind in your hair. You’re going fast, and it feels easy!

A bicycle gear system is like a set of **magic levers** that help your legs do the right amount of work for the situation.
